scope: prospective engineering acceptance baseline; not trade authorization or natural-day result

cohort.initial_state: Each database contains only account(init, cash=100000, equity=100000); zero positions, orders and trades.

calendar.verification_boundary: Local calendar observation only; independently reconfirm the actual exchange session and data archive on the candidate day.

counting_rules: The candidate day counts toward M2 only after real on-time publication, current six-role remote review evidence, deterministic decision/Paper settlement, comparison and authorized notification receipt are independently verified.
M3 five-session counting begins only after M2 acceptance; a failure or late version is retained and restarts the passing streak without rewriting this cohort start.
A justified no-trade day may test operational continuity; simulated or historical fills do not prove alpha or Live readiness.
A policy or calendar change is recorded as a new version, not silently merged into one performance series.
